PDF Dimensionality reduction on multi-dimensional transfer functions for ...
Abstract The design of transfer functions for volume rendering is a non-trivial task. This is particularly true for multi-channel data sets, where multiple data values exist for each voxel, which require multi-dimensional transfer func-tions. In this article, we propose a new method for multi-dimensional transfer function design.
